data.name: Ateef
data.gender_notes: Ateef is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'athara' which means 'to console' or 'to please'. In Islamic history, Ateef is the name of a companion of Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) known for his comforting and consoling nature towards the Prophet and his companions. The name Ateef carries the meaning “Consoling, Comforting” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ateef usually hope their child will grow to embody consoling, comforting and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes comfort, consolation, and support in times of hardship.
data.etymology: Ateef belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Consoling, Comforting.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ateef total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
